spec.title: Data / evidence boundaries
spec.body:
SPLIT WHOLE FAMILIES
Train / validation / holdout assigned before variants.
Audit all splits together; reject request/family leakage.

BIND EVERY LABEL
Offered actions + independent acceptable-action sets.
Pin engine, generator, teacher, rights and evidence.
Prediction is not a teacher; build success is not conformance.

REPLAY BEFORE CLAIMING CAPABILITY
Independent geometry / electrical outcome checks.
Preserve failed attempts; freeze checkpoint + corpus.

Inventory snapshot, not live training or admission proof.

spec.title: Students / two separate architectures
spec.body:
TAIGA REPRODUCTION · RETAINED S1
Width 128 · feed-forward 384 · four heads.
Three encoder blocks → two decoder blocks.
Typed state / goal / candidate tokens.
Separate upstream training and frozen comparison.

NATIVE UMIE POLICY · IMPLEMENTED
Single pre-LN transformer block · four-head attention.
Residual attention → GELU feed-forward → linear score.
Deterministic domain encoders + bounded candidates.
CPU reference / resident CUDA / resident Metal.

Do not conflate the retained S1 and native policy.

spec.title: Owner pipeline / current limits
spec.body:
DOMAIN OWNERS
Typed goals + revision-bound geometry → offered actions.
Transmog executes; engineering checks remain external.

PRIVATE DATA → COMPUTE → REPLAY
Teacher → independent admission → source-isolated corpus.
Versioned encoder → validated recipe → UMIE training.
Pinned checkpoint → validation selection → native replay.

EXPLORATORY / NOT GENERAL CAD
Broader-family recovery episodes remain planned.
Primitive fixtures do not establish production admission.
No general printability or engine certification.

Static architecture view · no fabricated live metrics.
